digest.subject: Your price drop and offer alerts

priceDrop.sectionTitle: Price dropped on your saved accommodations

claimNotice.subject: Claim the Partner {{partnerName}} on Hospeda
claimNotice.heading: We approved {{partnerName}}'s application
claimNotice.body: To manage it, open the link below and sign in with the account associated with this email. That account will own the Partner.
claimNotice.singleUse: This personal link can only be used once. If we sent you an earlier one, it no longer works. Do not forward it.
claimNotice.ignore: If you did not apply to become a Hospeda Partner, you can ignore this email.

claimNoticeDirect.preview: The Hospeda team created the Partner {{partnerName}}
claimNoticeDirect.heading: The Hospeda team created the Partner {{partnerName}}
claimNoticeDirect.body: To manage it, claim it: open the link below and sign in with the account associated with this email. That account will own the Partner.
claimNoticeDirect.ignore: If you were not expecting this email, you do not need to do anything.

rejected.subject: Your Hospeda Partner application
rejected.heading: We reviewed your application
rejected.body: We are unable to approve it this time.

manualInstallmentOpened.subject: You have an installment to pay on Hospeda
manualInstallmentOpened.heading: Your installment is ready to pay
manualInstallmentOpened.introFirst: We set up your Partner subscription. Here are the details of your first installment.
manualInstallmentOpened.introRenewal: The installment for a new period of your Partner subscription is open.

latePaymentRefunded.subject: We refunded a payment that arrived late
latePaymentRefunded.heading: We refunded your payment
latePaymentRefunded.intro: Your payment for {{product}} reached us after the purchase had already closed, so the add-on was not activated.
latePaymentRefunded.timing: Depending on your payment method, it may take a few days to show up.
latePaymentRefunded.closing: If you still want the add-on, you can buy it again from your account.
